title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit with the model of your choice in PowerPoint
description: When create or edit a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint, you can now select which model to use, including both Open AI and Anthropic models. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot–licensed users.
